revisions.author: Susanto
revisions.description: Newly created in the UISS review (docs/review 04 M1): menu tree and role access of the existing TC-PBR mock-up; ELIPS tables MASTER_MENU, USERID_*; class names TBD

objective: To document the TC-PBR menu tree and which role may view / execute each function, as implemented in the mock-up.
To map menus and roles to the existing ELIPS authorization tables (MASTER_MENU, USERID_CLASS, USERID_MENU_OPTION, USERID_DETAIL).
